@@U02515@@
Stand by me, for I will need you often
when the routine of your daily world distresses me.

@@U02517@@
(Enters in haste.)

@@U02518@@
Serene Highness, I never thought
that one day I would bring to you news
of such great good fortune!
I am blessed in your presence, Majesty,
with supreme happiness!
Our accounts are settled, every bill paid,
we have escaped the usurer’s clutches,
and I am relieved of the torments of Hell!
Heaven could not be more joyous!

@@U02520@@
(Following in haste.)

@@U02521@@
Sire, we've begun to pay off the mercenaries,
and the whole army’s reenlisted!
The troops are in fine fettle, and tapster and tart
are about their trades!

@@U02523@@
How freely you're all breathing for a change!
Your faces have lost their folds and are smiling again!
And to think you ran to tell me!

@@U02525@@
(Who has already entered.)

@@U02526@@
These are the men you should ask, Sire.
It was they who did it.

@@U02528@@
By right,
I think the Chancellor should explain it.

@@U02530@@
(Approaching slowly.)

@@U02531@@
Yes, whose old age is finally blest.
Hear now and behold this fateful paper
that has turned all woe to weal.

@@U02532@@
(He reads.)
translation:
@@U02515@@
站在我身边，因为我经常需要你
当你的日常生活让我感到苦恼时。

@@U02517@@
（匆匆进来。）

@@U02518@@
殿下，我没想到
有一天我会给你带来消息
真是太幸运了！
陛下，我因您的存在而感到幸福，
带着至高无上的幸福！
我们的账目已经结清，每笔账单都已支付，
我们逃离了高利贷者的魔掌，
我就从地狱的折磨中解脱出来了！
天堂不能更欢乐了！

@@U02520@@
（连忙跟上。）

@@U02521@@
陛下，我们已经开始偿还雇佣兵的钱了
并且全军重新入伍！
部队士气高昂，酒鬼和酒鬼
是关于他们的交易！

@@U02523@@
你们多么自由地呼吸着改变！
你们脸上的皱纹消失了，又露出笑容了！
没想到你跑来告诉我了！

@@U02525@@
（谁已经进来了。）

@@U02526@@
这些是您应该询问的人，陛下。
是他们干的。

@@U02528@@
依理说，
我认为总理应该解释一下。

@@U02530@@
（慢慢靠近。）

@@U02531@@
是的，他的晚年终于得到了祝福。
现在听听并看看这篇至关重要的论文
这已将一切祸患转为福祉。

@@U02532@@
（他读着。）
